newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 65 bln dmk in repo at 3.00 percent.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 65 bln dmk in repo at 3.00 percent.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it allocated 65 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed interest rate of three percent.
A repo pact for 65.0 billion marks at a fixed 3.30 percent rate percent expires today, Wednesday, so the new tender exactly replaces the expiring pact.

The Bundesbank said banks bid for 195.4 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 33.25 percent of the bids. The Bundesbank last Thursday slashed its repo rate by 30 basis points in the first change in the rate since February.
